data.name: Furious Charge
data.description: A mounted fury learns to make more accurate charge attacks while mounted. The mounted fury and his mount receive a +4 bonus on melee attack rolls on a charge while mounted (instead of the normal +2). In addition, the mounted fury and his mount don't take any penalty to AC after making a charge attack while mounted.
